errors.text: The predicted mechanical outcome is opposite to the target: it predicts fracture strain below 5% and dominant embrittlement, whereas the Cr-containing alloy reaches about 14.0% fracture strain, a roughly 20.6% improvement over the baseline.
The testing condition is incorrectly specified as uniaxial tension rather than room-temperature compression.

The falsification rule incorrectly treats fracture-strain improvement as evidence against the hypothesis, even though improved plasticity from crack hindrance by the reticulated Laves phase is central to the target mechanism.
